notes.text: The author introduces a hexagonal diagram numbered (40), writes two interior cart labels, and describes the marked b, b-prime and s-prime morphisms as immersions bordantes, with propres inserted. The following paragraph calls s and the barred p fibrantes et propres in the stated équisingulier case, and describes the boundaries of fibres by images of the written Sigma expressions. These are reports of the manuscript’s assertions; no proof or separate mathematical verification was performed.

The added i.e. explanation describes pairs (x prec y) for which y ne soit pas successeur de x. The oblique note begins donc, and describes the fibré des bords as an image of a Sigma expression with argument 3. The final paragraph says the fibrating applications have rien de surjectif, then describes the image of s using nonmaximal x and the image of p using pairs with nonmaximal y. Both occurrences of formé are retained exactly; they were not regularised to formée.

There is no visible authorial page number at the head. The diagram’s (40) is at the left, and pale foliation 63 at the bottom belongs to another hand. Fifteen main prose baselines are counted; the diagram, oblique margin baselines and interlinear additions are inventoried separately. The strokes in morphismes were checked and show heavy joins rather than an independently isolable cancellation.

Readings were chosen from local ink, with no mathematical identity used to replace one Sigma mark by another. The central diagram exponent and the lower body-map target are crossed stars; compact other forms retain explicit alternatives. A small dark mark above the s of the first body map may be a pen-start or a prime. The cancelled label and word, overdrawn brace, voire/voir ending, marginal terminal mark and later s underline remain doubtful.

The diagram setting preserves seven objects and nine edges, counting the double visible tracing of s-prime as one edge with two shafts. Broken source decorations retain their component counts, gaps and the one faint piece. b-prime in the diagram is underlined beneath b only, while the s-prime underline reaches under the prime position. Curved insertion leaders around propres and the i.e. explanation are recorded as attachment marks rather than added text parentheses.

Audit boxes B04–B06 merge adjacent or vertically overlapping writing so that their readings include all foreground text, insertions and margin material inside each rectangle; B06 includes the entire remaining lower block and foliation. This avoids submitting boxes whose readings silently discard intersecting marginal or interlinear strokes. Root may subdivide these source rectangles when finalising the blind-audit list.
